sources.entry: ChitChat - Native Mac app wrapper for WhatsApp Web.

summary.one_liner: ChitChat (formerly WhatsMac) is a native Mac app that wraps the WhatsApp Web client in a window with Notification Center alerts and extra keyboard shortcuts.
summary.what_it_does: The app loads WhatsApp Web inside a native macOS window, so you can use WhatsApp from the desktop without a browser tab. It forwards new message alerts to Notification Center. It adds keyboard shortcuts: ⌘N to start a new conversation, ⌘F to search past conversations, ⌘1 through ⌘9 to jump to the 1st through 9th most recent conversation, and arrow keys to scroll the conversation list. Text chat, viewing and downloading attached media, and notifications are marked as working. Media uploading works only by dragging a file into the window; the upload button is not supported. Media recording is not supported. The README says the project does not reverse engineer the WhatsApp API; all communication with WhatsApp servers is handled by WhatsApp Web itself.
use_cases: Use WhatsApp on a Mac without a browser tab
Get WhatsApp message notifications in Notification Center
Jump between recent WhatsApp chats with keyboard shortcuts
Search WhatsApp conversations from the desktop
Drag photos or videos into WhatsApp Web on a Mac
stack: Objective-C/Swift (WKWebView, implied by README mention of WKWebView)
notable: Wraps WhatsApp Web as a native macOS app, similar in spirit to a Safari clone
Notification Center alerts for new messages
Keyboard shortcuts for new chat, search, and jumping to recent conversations
Drag-and-drop media upload into the app window
Based in part on code from Messenger for Mac by Rasmus Andersson
caveats: Requires OS X 10.10 Yosemite or later and a device compatible with WhatsApp Web
Media upload via the upload button is not supported; media recording is not supported
Unofficial hobby project, not an official WhatsApp product
